description: Sandbox only. Marks the order's eSIM as installed and used, as if the traveler activated it. Use it to exercise refund and dispute rules.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

data_used_mb.description: Data the simulated traveler used, in MB (default 120)

order_id.description: Order id from purchase (order.order_id) or from an earlier order_status call

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: sandbox_simulate_activation
title: Sandbox: simulate eSIM activation
